subject: Request for tailored SLA credit & contract addendum — PineTree Health
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@pinetree.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production latency incidents — request for credit + SLO amendment
Attachments: incident-timeline-20261115.pdf (pdf), usage-report-oct2026.csv (csv)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking a look — we've attached a short timeline and our usage report for October. On 2026-11-15 we observed a sustained latency spike across our Primary US-West region between 02:10–04:45 PDT that pushed median p95 beyond our contractual SLO for several hours. The incident impacted API calls for background ingestion and customer-facing recommendations.

Our legal & procurement teams have asked us to request a formal remediation package: specifically, a concession in the form of either (A) one free month of service plus a credit tied to next quarter usage, or (B) a prorated monetary credit reflecting the hours impacted. We'd also like Redwood to sign a brief SLO addendum clarifying multi-region failover behavior and alerting thresholds.

Can you confirm what level of concession Redwood can approve without exec signoff, and whether your team can send the SLO addendum for review?

We appreciate the quick turnaround — PineTree is evaluating renewal timing and this will factor materially.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Head of Platform
PineTree Health

P.S. Contact for procurement: procurement@pinetree.health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@pinetree.health>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production latency incidents — request for credit + SLO amendment
Attachments: slo-amendment-draft.docx (docx)

Alex — thanks for the detail and the attachments. I'm really sorry PineTree hit that window; I know this impacted some critical flows.

I've looped in Marissa (account lead), Rachel (ops), Kimberly (finance) and Jonas (legal) to scope an offer that balances remediation, precedent, and our renewal cadence. To get us moving, here are three options we can consider for PineTree — please tell me which aligns with your expectation:

1) Goodwill + SLO addendum: 1 free month of service (applied as a credit) + sign the SLO addendum. Fastest to approve, low precedent risk.

2) Tiered usage credit: 30% credit applied to PineTree's next quarterly invoice, capped at a dollar amount (internal cap required). Requires finance signoff.

3) Prorated monetary credit: calculated from affected window and average usage during the month (requires incident analysis & exec approval if > $50k).

Internally, if PineTree is comfortable with option (1) or (2) within a reasonable cap, we can route this without CEO approval. If they prefer a larger one-off monetary settlement (> $50k), we will need exec authorization.

Marissa / Kimberly / Rachel / Jonas — can each weigh in on which option we should present and the maximum cap you can authorize? I'm also attaching a draft SLO addendum for initial review.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, alex.moreno@pinetree.health
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Production latency incidents — request for credit + SLO amendment

Karthik / Alex — quick recommendation from AE perspective: propose option (1) with an enhanced cap that protects PineTree and keeps renewal momentum. My suggested customer-facing package: 

- One free month applied as immediate credit to the next invoice.
- 30% credit on usage for the next full quarter, capped at $75,000.
- SLO addendum signature (we will request acceptance within 14 days).

Rationale: signals good will and preserves renewal negotiations. If Finance pushes back on $75k we can request an alternative cap and amortize the value.

Alex — if you're aligned, I can draft the customer-facing email and DocuSign with the addendum after finance/ops/legal confirm the cap.

— Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Production latency incidents — request for credit + SLO amendment

Team — ran the numbers against the attached usage-report-oct2026.csv. PineTree's average monthly bill for the trailing 3 months is ~$210,000. A 30% credit on a single quarter would be materially high; we should limit exposure. My recommendation: cap at $60,000 and amortize as follows to reduce cashflow impact:

- Apply one free month (estimated $70k value) as credit upfront.
- Apply remaining concession as a percentage discount (up to $60k cap) spread over the next two monthly invoices (i.e., up to $30k/month).

Calculation (approx):
- One free month: $70,000 (based on avg usage)
- Remaining cap available for discount: $60,000
- If PineTree's next quarter usage is below projected, actual credit will be prorated.

This approach keeps the total concession <= $130,000 and aligns with our finance approval thresholds. Anything above $130k needs exec approval.

If Ops/legal confirm the addendum language, finance can approve this structure.

— Kimberly
Dir, Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Production latency incidents — request for credit + SLO amendment

Quick legal/ops note and sign-off condition:

- I reviewed the draft SLO addendum. We're ok to proceed with Marissa/Kimberly's proposed structure conditioned on PineTree's countersignature to the addendum and acceptance of standard post-incident monitoring requirements (we'll require they enable real-time latency alerts and a runbook for their support engineers).

- With those conditions, legal will approve the addendum and finance can proceed with the amortized cap at $60k + free month as proposed. This keeps precedent manageable and ties remediation to instrumented detection.

Approve to move forward to customer with the following final language: 
"Redwood will issue one month of service credit; additionally Redwood will provide a usage-based credit up to $60,000 amortized over two invoices, contingent on PineTree's countersignature of the attached SLO addendum within 14 days."

Please confirm and I'll attach the final addendum for signature.

— Jonas
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
